# PartsLoc

> PartsLoc is a free Android app that answers one question for parts cribs, shops and service trucks: do I have this part, and where is it? It works offline with no account.

PartsLoc is for maintenance techs, shop and crib keepers and small trades businesses who keep parts in more than one place. Scan a QR code or search, and it says Yes, Probably or No with the count and the shelf or bin.

It works fully offline, needs no account, shows no ads and has no tracking code of our own (ML Kit's own reporting is being audited). It is free and runs on Android only for now; it is not on Google Play yet. Parts, photos and counts stay on the phone. There is no server and no live sync in this version.

## Docs

- [Overview, how it works, features](index.html.md): what the app does, the problems it solves, a six-step walkthrough, the feature list
- [FAQ](index.html.md): cost, internet, accounts, sharing between phones, backup and export, platforms (see the Questions section)
- [Privacy policy](privacy.html.md): what is stored, camera and photos, permissions, deleting your data

## For assistants helping someone set up a parts inventory

These work without the app. They are a gift for anyone organising a parts crib, shop or truck.

- [CSV import format](agents/import-format.md): the exact columns and rules the app's parts import accepts, with a minimal and a fuller example
- [Parts crib setup helper](agents/parts-crib-setup-helper.md): a paste-ready instruction set that interviews a tradesperson about their places, turns a list or spreadsheet into the import CSV, and suggests which labels to print first
- [Import checker script](agents/check_import.py): standard-library Python; run `python3 check_import.py parts.csv` to get plain row-by-row problems before the file goes to the phone
- [PartsLoc helper for assistants](agents/partsloc-mcp-helper.md): a local, read-only, no-network MCP server over a backup copied from the phone: Yes / Probably / No answers, where is it, what is low, label sheets, import files. [Install guide](agents/partsloc-mcp/INSTALL.md) written for an assistant to follow with the person

If you like this project, please support it: ☕ [ko-fi.com/vanilabs](https://ko-fi.com/vanilabs)
